reviews.text:
Great taste, noticeable improvement in digestion

I've been taking this for a while now and I'm happy with it. It has a nice, pleasant taste which makes it easy to stick to daily, unlike a lot of probiotic supplements. I noticed a real improvement in my digestion since starting it — feels lighter and more regular. Will definitely keep repurchasing.
reviews.zh:
味道好好，消化明顯改善

我食咗呢款一段時間，好滿意。味道好好，令人好易每日堅持食，唔似好多益生菌補充劑咁。我開始食之後真係見到消化有改善，感覺輕身啲，排便都更規律。會繼續再買。

reviews.text: Easy to take and pleasant taste. It feels gentle on my stomach and helps with digestion when used regularly. Convenient stick packaging and good quality overall. I’m happy with the results.
reviews.zh: 易食，味道好好。食得經常嘅話，對腸胃好温和，又幫助消化。條裝包裝方便，整體質素都好好。我對效果好滿意。

reviews.text: These probiotics taste pleasant and are easy to take daily. I noticed less bloating and a more regular digestive routine. Great for anyone who wants a simple wellness boost
reviews.zh: 呢款益生菌味道好好，每日都容易食。我留意到脹氣減少咗，腸胃運作都規律咗。適合任何想簡單提升健康嘅人。

reviews.text: Love mild pineapple flavoured kombucha. Sachet sticks are very convenient to carry with you whenever you go. You can take with still or sparkling water. I have noticed that the bloatedness reduced, so I am going to continue taking it.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意味道温和嘅菠蘿味康普茶。條裝小包好方便，隨時隨地都可以帶住。可以用無汽水或者有汽水沖飲。我留意到肚脹減少咗，所以我會繼續食。

reviews.text: I got this for my colleague at work and she loved it..I tried it and I like it too..it’s like a fizzy drink but helps a lot with bloating after eating..I definitely recommend
reviews.zh: 我買咗畀同事，佢好鍾意……我試過都幾鍾意……好似汽水咁，但係對食完嘢肚脹好有幫助……我一定推薦

reviews.text: This powdered Kombucha drink from @everbikini_official is the best-tasting kombucha that I have ever tried. The pineapple flavor tastes perfect. I love to drink it after lunch to aid digestion. It comes in 30 sachets (good for 30 days).
reviews.zh: 呢款 @everbikini_official 嘅粉狀康普茶飲品，係我試過味道最好嘅康普茶。菠蘿味好完美。我好鍾意午飯後飲，幫助消化。包裝入面有 30 小包（夠食 30 日）。

reviews.text: The summer is so hot and a kombucha with cold water is so refreshing, i love it every day I drink like 2 bottles of this the pineapple is so refreshing and the taste is so good
reviews.zh: 夏天好熱，用凍水沖一杯康普茶好清涼，我每日都好鍾意，每日飲大約兩樽。菠蘿味好清爽，味道好好。

note: 以下評價由 YesStyle 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
